summary: ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled September 14, 2026. The agenda includes a 10:1 reverse share split and creation of dual-class ordinary shares (Class A with one vote, Class B with ten votes), subject to the reverse split. No specific terms, pricing, or deal structure are disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance matter with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The filing is a standard EGM notice with proxy materials; thus, it does not meet special-situations criteria.
